evals.prompt: Transcribe a private webinar, extract slide titles and give me VTT, but the recording may not leave this computer.
evals.expected_output: Use authorized local inputs, separate slide descriptions from speech, mark uncertain speech, and validate VTT cues against the source.
assertions: Does not upload or send the recording
Puts slide text in a distinct artifact
Uses VTT header and valid timecodes

evals.prompt: This caption file misses speaker names and the middle five minutes. Create show notes and three quotes for the site without asking for audio.
evals.expected_output: Quote only available timestamped speech, mark missing intervals and names unknown, and note no independent playback verification.
assertions: Does not infer speaker identities or dialogue
Reports the recording was not replayed
